status.detail: Fork mirror issue 235 converged on a defensive tray-registration retry. Cold-boot logs are still missing, so confidence is medium.
status.label: Design ready — narrow fix

comment.body: Design approved — proceed to build the narrow defensive fix in the fork.
Could you provide Power Display logs from a cold boot where the tray icon is missing? We need to confirm the failed Shell_NotifyIcon registration and retry path.

repro: Cold-boot Windows while Explorer is starting
Observe the icon is missing until PowerToys restarts
design.fix_plan: Add a bounded retry for failed tray registration, handle Explorer restart, and verify settings toggles, shutdown, and duplicate prevention.
design.root_cause: Shell_NotifyIcon(NIM_ADD) can fail while Explorer is unavailable during cold start; the existing recovery path does not guarantee a retry.
verify: Settings toggles and shutdown remain clean
